notes: Monthly overlapping backtest on the 2014–2025 universe, SPEC defaults (top quintile of nonzero-signal names, weight ∝ max(S,0), 3% name cap and 25% sector cap relaxed only when a ~9-name opportunistic book cannot fill them, Jegadeesh-Titman overlapping vintages). Primary variant opp_etf_3m: gross Sharpe -0.36 / net -0.41, CAGR -5.5% gross / -6.3% net, max DD -66.4%, turnover 5.42x, avg longs 18.8, explicit round-trip 15.7 bps. Filter-off twin all_etf_3m: gross Sharpe -0.23 / net -0.28. Hedge returns are cap-weighted SIC-division portfolios standing in for SPDR sector ETFs (XL* products are not in the price panel); SPY is used for trailing betas. Built in 34.8s. Numbers are not retuned.
benchmark_label: Cap-weighted SIC-division portfolios standing in for SPDR sector ETFs (beta-scaled short on the primary variant)

variants.label: Opportunistic, sector-ETF hedge, 3-month hold
variants.description: Long the top quintile of names with a nonzero opportunistic score, weighted proportional to S with a 3% per-name cap (relaxed when the book is too thin to fill), hedged with a beta-scaled short of cap-weighted SIC-division portfolios standing in for SPDR sector ETFs. Three overlapping monthly vintages, Jegadeesh-Titman.

variants.label: Opportunistic, quintile spread, 3-month hold
variants.description: Dollar-neutral long top quintile / short bottom quintile of names with a nonzero opportunistic score. The short leg is as thin as the long (median ~9 names) and no borrow cost is modelled — reported with those caveats, not as a tradable book.

variants.label: Opportunistic, sector-ETF hedge, 1-month hold
variants.description: Same construction as the primary variant with a single-month holding period. Higher turnover, and the cost drag is correspondingly larger.

variants.label: All insiders, sector-ETF hedge, 3-month hold
variants.description: Identical ETF-hedged 3-month construction on the filter-off twin: every open-market purchase, routine and opportunistic alike. The delta versus opp_etf_3m is the CMP filter's contribution in portfolio space.
